item.title: Google Adds ‘Personal Intelligence’ To AI Mode in Search, Using Opt-In Gmail And Photos Context
item.description: Google is expanding “Personal Intelligence” to AI Mode in Google Search, enabling paying Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S. to opt in and connect Gmail and Google Photos so AI Mode can deliver more personalized answers. item.title: Spotify Expands Prompted Playlists Beta To Premium Users In The U.S. And Canada
item.description: Spotify is expanding its Prompted Playlist feature in beta to more Premium listeners, rolling it out across the U.S. and Canada beginning January 22, 2026. The product, which Spotify began testing with Premium users in New Zealand in December 2025, is designed to let listeners generate playlists by describing what they want to hear in their own words, with results tailored by both their listening history and what’s trending in music in the moment. item.title: Clorox To Buy Purell Maker GOJO For $2.25 Billion, Expanding Health And Hygiene Push
item.description: The Clorox Company announced it has agreed to acquire GOJO Industries, the Ohio-based maker of Purell hand sanitizer and other skin health and hygiene products, in a deal valued at $2.25 billion in cash. Clorox said the purchase price includes anticipated tax benefits of about $330 million, implying a net purchase price of $1.92 billion. item.title: Superstate Raises $82.5 Million Series B To Expand Onchain Equity Issuance
item.description: Superstate announced it has closed an $82.5 million Series B financing as the company expands from tokenized Treasury products into infrastructure that enables SEC-registered public companies to issue and manage tokenized shares directly on public blockchains. item.title: BCI Names Jon Salon Global Head Of Private Equity, Succeeding Jim Pittman
item.description: British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) has appointed Jon Salon as Executive Vice President and Global Head of Private Equity, effective February 2, 2026. Salon will lead BCI Private Equity’s C$36 billion-plus program and succeeds Jim Pittman, who has led the platform since 2016 and is departing BCI at the end of January.
